sources.title: Finding information held by HM Land Registry
sources.role: Property-summary, register and plan access guidance.
sources.facts: Explains available property summaries, title registers, title plans and related searches.
sources.guard: Title plans, INSPIRE polygons, index-map results and local-land-charge records do not by themselves prove legal boundaries, beneficial ownership, covenant enforceability, planning permission or absence of unregistered interests.

sources.title: HM Land Registry plans: title plan (PG40s5)
